messages:
ryan: Flagging a token-spend bump after the recent routing weight rollout. cost dashboard shows a step but it's unclear which change created it. anyone on rollout-preview math?

sophia: I saw it too. morning window had more fallbacks to model:open-large. preview UI only shows an aggregate estimate today.

diego: We should show a per-variant projected $ delta. simple sim: proj_delta = sum((new_prob - baseline_prob) * invocations * avg_tokens * price_per_token).

maya: Agreed. UX: one-line $/hr estimate + expandable breakdown (tokens, cache effect, price per model) and a confidence badge.

ryan: Cache matters. propose effective_tokens = median_tokens * (1 - cache_hit_rate) + prefetch_cost. that gives a better dollar sim.

sophia: Telemetry query to get per-variant medians and hit rates:

SELECT model_variant, approx_percentile(tokens,0.5) as median_tokens, avg(cache_hit::int) as hit_rate, count(*) as samples
FROM invocation_samples
WHERE route = '/generate' AND ts > now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY model_variant;

sophia: I'll expose a small endpoint that returns these stats for the preview. will sample to control cost.

diego: Add a "worst-case" toggle that assumes cache_hit_rate=0 to show potential downside.

maya: Governance: default soft-budget for early rollouts: alert at +25% for 10m and auto-pause if +100% for 5m. include tooltip copy.

deploy-bot: [deploy] rollout-preview v0.63 promoted to staging at 2026-06-11T09:12Z.

ryan: Follow-ups: (1) $/hr projected delta + expandable breakdown, (2) show per-variant cache assumptions with override, (3) soft-budget controls, (4) compare to 7d median baseline checkbox, (5) "explain assumptions" link.

sophia: Made a grafana: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/abc123/variant-costs with median tokens + hit rates. will grant PM access.

diego: I'll prototype server sim and reuse billing.pricing_v2.

maya: I'll add Figma mock for the one-liner and soft-budget controls. linking in a follow-up.

ryan: Filing INF-8810 with acceptance: preview shows $/hr, expandable tokens/cache/model breakdown, soft-budget controls, worst-case toggle, telemetry endpoint documented.

diego: INF-8810 created. tagging @sophia @maya.

maya: Please include the assumptions panel in the UI so it isn't magic.

sophia: will do. sample rate, time window, and price table version will be visible.

ryan: Locking this. we'll hold on auto-roll for >10 tenants until we validate predictions for 3 weeks. Thanks team.
